featured_reviews.name: Maithilee Warang
featured_reviews.review_text:
The ashram is really good I kept my nani, and I must say it is a very peaceful and caring place for elderly people. The environment is calm, clean, and well-maintained, which makes the residents feel comfortable and safe.

The food provided at the ashram is very good and healthy. Meals are served on time and are freshly prepared, keeping in mind the health and dietary needs of the elderly. The staff members are kind, patient, and always ready to help the residents with anything they need.

The care given to everyone here is truly heart-warming. The staff regularly checks on the residents and makes sure they are comfortable, happy, and healthy. They treat everyone with respect and affection, almost like family.

One of the best things about this ashram is the positive and friendly atmosphere. The residents spend time together talking, sharing stories, and supporting each other. They often play devotional songs and music, which creates a peaceful and spiritual environment. Sometimes they also sing together, celebrate small festivals, and enjoy group activities that keep everyone engaged.

The place is very clean and organized, with proper rooms, good ventilation, and peaceful surroundings. It truly feels like a home rather than just an institution. When we kept our nani her weight was very low she wasn't healthy but because of ashram she became very healthy and strong

Overall, this ashram is a wonderful place for elderly people to stay. It provides good food, proper care, companionship, and a peaceful lifestyle. I feel happy knowing that my nani is in such a loving and supportive environment.

We had brought with us food and some snacks which we distributed amongst the members🥳. They were ecstatic to have food from outside♥️🥰. I went to talk individually to everyone.
I went over to an elderly lady who was sitting at the corner of the room, staring at the glass window. I introduced myself and took a seat besides her.✨ She greeted me with a smile and gave me a ballon which she had in her room♥️.  She became emotional while narrating the story and then advised me to never do that with my parents in their old age. 🤧She said that parents need care in their old age as they had cared for their children all their life.👀💘

The visit to the old-age home was a fulfilling experience for me as I came back home with not only memories but also some valuable lessons✨♥️. When I reached home, I ran straight to my mother and hugged her tight saying that I would never abandon her or my father when they grew old.🥰

And all thanks toh Vaibhavi thakur because if her i got the opportunity to meet all the cutiees out there.😍♥️🥳😘

featured_reviews.name: Nitin vishwakarma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I first visited Narayan Chandra Trust about two years ago for their free computer classes, and since then my experience has been amazing. The staff is always polite, supportive, and treats everyone with respect. The environment is clean, peaceful, and full of greenery.

I’ve also seen how they manage their women’s hostel and senior citizens’ hostel, and I was really impressed. The staff there is very caring and helpful, and they make sure the members feel safe and comfortable.

Thanks to NCT, I learned a lot and have now become a mentor, teaching new students just like I once learned. I’m truly grateful to be part of this place and highly recommend it to anyone looking to learn and grow.

featured_reviews.name: Kamlesh singh Rajput
featured_reviews.review_text: I've pinpointed the Narayan Chandra Trust as a versatile nonprofit centered in Maharashtra, with a strong footprint in Nalasopara and Virar. Their work revolves around three key areas: a compassionate care facility for seniors offering assisted living and nursing support, a safe and budget-friendly hostel tailored for working women, and an education initiative delivering hands-on training in digital skills, robotics, and computing for kids and orphans. Overall, their efforts focus deeply on community needs, promoting respect for the aged and empowerment for the younger generation.

featured_reviews.name: Taufik Sheikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I first visited Narayan Chandra Trust (NCT) nearly two years ago with the simple goal of joining their free computer classes. What I found, however, was much more than just a place to learn computer skills. Over time, NCT became a source of knowledge, confidence, guidance, and inspiration for me.

The environment at Narayan Chandra Trust is extremely clean, peaceful, and full of greenery, which creates a very positive and motivating atmosphere for learning. The entire campus reflects discipline, simplicity, and a true spirit of service. The staff members are always polite, supportive, and respectful. Every student is treated equally, whether they are new or old, which makes everyone feel valued and comfortable.

Through NCT, I not only gained technical knowledge in computers but also learned important life values. The teachers explain concepts in a very simple, practical, and encouraging manner. They understand the strengths and needs of each student and guide them accordingly. Because of this approach, students gain confidence and move toward becoming self-reliant.

I also had the opportunity to observe the management of the women’s hostel and the senior citizens’ hostel run by the Trust. I was truly impressed by the care, safety, and organization provided there. Both hostels are well-maintained, secure, and comfortable. The staff is kind, attentive, and genuinely concerned about the well-being of the residents. The respect and care shown toward senior citizens, in particular, is admirable and sets a great example for society.

One of the greatest strengths of Narayan Chandra Trust is that it does not only provide education or facilities, but also inspires people to become better human beings. Values such as service, discipline, cooperation, and self-reliance are deeply encouraged here.

Today, I feel proud to say that after learning at NCT, I have become a mentor myself and now teach new students just as I once learned. This is a matter of honor and gratitude for me. Narayan Chandra Trust gave me the opportunity to learn, the courage to move forward, and the inspiration to give back to society.

I sincerely express my gratitude to Narayan Chandra Trust and highly recommend this institution to anyone who is looking to learn, grow, and bring positive change into their life.
